name: Waterfall.io
description: B2B contact/company intelligence API: waterfall enrichment across 30+ vendors for contacts, companies, emails, phones, prospecting and job-change tracking.
access_notes: API-first product with usage-based prepaid pricing, but the official site's only CTA is 'Book a call' (with founders) to discuss use case; no public self-serve signup or published price list found on waterfall.io. Docs include an 'API Key Management' endpoint for creating sub-keys under a master key, implying keys are provisioned per customer.
mcp_notes: No vendor MCP announcement found (searched waterfall.io site and web for 'waterfall.io MCP'); no Waterfall toolkit in the docs.composio.dev/toolkits catalog.
uncertainty_notes: Verified this is the contact/company-intel product (api.waterfall.io, docs.waterfall.io) and not another 'Waterfall' brand. Access is the main unknown: third-party reviews (leadsforge.ai, coldiq.com) claim 'every user gets an API key after signing up', but I found no self-serve signup flow on official pages, so recording contact_sales per official site. API is enrichment/lookup-oriented (async launcher/finder jobs), effectively read-only data retrieval - hence narrow/partially_buildable despite solid REST docs. supports_webhooks=true refers to job-completion callbacks via webhook_url param.

evidence.note: 'The Waterfall API is available at https://api.waterfall.io. All requests require an API key in the x-api-key header.' Endpoint table: Prospector, Contact/Company/Phone Enrichment, Search, Email verification, Company Reveal, API Key Management.
Async job model (launcher returns job_id, finder retrieves results); optional webhook_url for job callbacks.
Prepaid top-up pricing model described in FAQ; getting started is via booking a call - no self-serve pricing/signup published.
Homepage markets the Prospector/Enrichment APIs with x-api-key examples; the only conversion CTA is 'Book a call' with the team/founders.
